premises.text: Talk media (podcasts/radio) remain long, non-interactive, and poorly suited to mobile-first ADD-generation creators unlike music, photos, and video
premises.evidence_span: They're long. They're not interactive. They don't really cater to the ADD generation, the mobile-first content creators

premises.text: Pundit is a social network for bite-sized talk shows where users invite friends or followers to participate in short audio conversations
premises.evidence_span: social network for voice experiences, where users can start bite-sized talk shows about their favorite topics and invite their friends or followers to participate

premises.text: Every piece of content is capped short (max ~30 seconds) with automatic noise reduction, voice engineering, filters, and background music
premises.evidence_span: every piece of content on Pundit is short and sweet

premises.text: Pundit Voice Box enables private disappearing voice messages (24 hours)
premises.evidence_span: send private voice messages that disappear in 24 hours

premises.text: Creators can share talks on other social platforms and natively embed them on any website, including web join without the app
premises.evidence_span: creators can share their Pundit talks on other social platforms and natively embed them on any website

premises.text: Brands and top creators can create and distribute audio content on the platform
premises.evidence_span: brands and top-notch creators to create and distribute awesome audio content

premises.text: Expansion to Android and Asian/Middle Eastern markets where voice interaction is already dominant
premises.evidence_span: releasing our Android version and launching in Asian and Middle Eastern markets
